definitions.explanation: A product, flavor, or menu item available only during a particular season, common for food, beverages, and snacks in Japan.

examples.japanese: {季節|きせつ}{限定|げんてい}フレーバー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: A seasonal limited flavor was released.

examples.japanese: ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{季節|きせつ}{限定|げんてい}⟦スイーツ→スイーツ：27370_suiitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I had the seasonal limited cherry blossom flavored sweets.

examples.japanese: {季節|きせつ}{限定|げんてい}⟦メニュー→メニュー：11166_menyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧です。
examples.english: The seasonal menu is only available until the end of this month.

notes:
{季節|きせつ}{限定|げんてい} products are extremely popular in Japan. Convenience stores, fast food chains, and snack manufacturers regularly release seasonal flavors like ⟦{桜|さくら}→桜：02212_sakura⟧ (cherry blossom) in spring and ⟦{栗|くり}→栗：04387_kuri⟧ (chestnut) in autumn.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {季節|きせつ}{限定|げんてい}⟦メニュー→メニュー：11166_menyuu⟧ (seasonal limited menu)
- {季節|きせつ}{限定|げんてい}フレーバー (seasonal limited flavor)
- {季節|きせつ}{限定|げんてい}⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧ (seasonal limited product)
